steps.body: One rule handles both operations: same signs give a positive result, different signs give a negative result — for multiplying OR dividing.

commonErrors.feedback: Same signs give a positive product: -6 × -7 = 42.

explanationVariants: Different signs give a negative quotient: -56 ÷ 8 = -7.
Negative divided by positive is negative.

commonErrors.feedback: Different signs give a NEGATIVE quotient: -56 ÷ 8 = -7.

steps.body: The very first step is always the same: check the signs before computing anything. That single glance decides positive or negative.

commonErrors.feedback: Different signs give a NEGATIVE product: 9 × -8 = -72.

steps.body: For three or more factors, count the negative signs — an odd count means negative, an even count means positive.

widget.prompt: -1 × -1 × -1 × -1 = ? Drag the marker to the product.

commonPlacements.feedback: Count the negatives: there are 4 (even), so the product is positive: 1.
That adds instead of multiplying. 1×1×1×1=1, and 4 negatives (even) keeps it positive.

widget.successFeedback: 4 negatives (even count) gives a positive product: 1 — the answer lands right of zero.
widget.lowFeedback: That landing is left of the answer. An even count of negative factors keeps the product positive.
widget.highFeedback: That landing is past the answer. Four 1s multiply to 1, and the even count of negatives keeps it positive.

predict.prompt: −1 × −1 × −1 × −1: four negative factors. The result's sign will be…

options.label: Positive — the minuses cancel in pairs
Negative — four minuses is deeply negative
Zero — they wipe each other out

predict.reveal: Each PAIR of negatives multiplies to +1, and four negatives make exactly two pairs: +1. Count the minus signs — even count means positive, odd leaves one unpaired minus standing. Cancelling never means zero: these are factors, not opposites being added.

That adds instead of multiplying. 5×2×2=20, and 3 negatives makes it -20.

steps.body: One sign rule covers both multiplication and division — check the signs first, every time.
takeaways: Same signs: result is positive. Different signs: result is negative.
This rule works identically for multiplying and dividing.
For 3+ factors, count the negatives — odd is negative, even is positive.
